title: Verify prime-runner claims against a live Prime Agent epic run
description: prime-runner.md is verified against prime-agent 0.7.0 source and docs, but never exercised end to end. Run a small epic with the adapter and confirm: worktree-process dispatch, --autonomous-gate behaviour, provider failover path, RLM watchdog settling a child that never replies, and detach/reattach of the orchestrator mid-run.
acceptance_criteria: A real epic completes under prime-runner.md; each claim above confirmed or corrected in the adapter
